statement_made: Having a guy like Fernando coming in at number one changes the energy in the building. We’re ready to let it fly.
event_description: Reacting to the Las Vegas Raiders selecting quarterback Fernando Mendoza with the first overall pick.

statement_made: David Bailey is a problem. Adding that kind of speed to the edge is going to make my job a whole lot easier.
event_description: Welcoming defensive end David Bailey to the New York Jets after his selection at No. 2 overall.

statement_made: Jeremiyah is the missing piece. You can't stack the box against him without leaving us one-on-one on the outside.
event_description: Discussing the dynamic of the Cardinals' offense following the draft of running back Jeremiyah Love.

statement_made: I’ve watched Carnell since Ohio State. He’s a technician, and I’m pumped to get to work with him in camp.
event_description: Expressing excitement over the Titans selecting wide receiver Carnell Tate at No. 4 overall.

statement_made: It’s weird not seeing Coach John on the sideline, but that’s the league. I wish him the best in New York.
event_description: Reflecting on head coach John Harbaugh’s departure from Baltimore to join the Giants.

statement_made: Coach Harbaugh has a plan for us. I’m just soaking up everything he says about game management.
event_description: Commenting on his first offseason working with new Giants head coach John Harbaugh.

statement_made: The knee feels great. I’m ahead of schedule and the Cheetah will be back on a field sooner than you think.
event_description: Providing an update on his ACL recovery and impending free agency after being released by Miami.

statement_made: Protecting Jaxson is my priority. Drafting Francis Mauigoa just makes that wall even stronger.
event_description: Reacting to the Giants' first-round selection of offensive lineman Francis Mauigoa.

statement_made: I’m happy for John. The Giants are getting a champion, but I told him I’m still the better coach in the family.
event_description: Joking about his brother John Harbaugh's new role with the New York Giants.

statement_made: The tender gives us some flexibility. I love what we’re building here in Pittsburgh and I’m not done yet.
event_description: Addressing the Steelers' decision to place an unrestricted free agent tender on him for the 2026 season.

statement_made: We want Aaron back. He’s a veteran leader who understands the standard we set here.
event_description: Confirming the team's desire to retain Aaron Rodgers following their 2025 playoff run.

statement_made: I’m ready to be the playmaker this city deserves. Nashville, let’s go to work.
event_description: First public statement after being drafted by the Tennessee Titans at No. 4 overall.

statement_made: Going top three is a blessing. I'm ready to show the Cardinals they made the right call passing on an edge rusher.
event_description: Draft night interview after being selected by the Arizona Cardinals.

statement_made: The New York Sack Exchange is back open for business. See you on Sundays.
event_description: Addressing Jets fans after his selection as the No. 2 overall pick.

statement_made: I don't care where I was drafted, I just care about what I do next. The film will speak for itself.
event_description: Reacting to his draft selection and sliding out of the top five.

statement_made: I’m grateful for my time in Miami. To the fans, thanks for everything. Next chapter starts now.
event_description: Bidding farewell to the Dolphins after being released in a salary cap move.

statement_made: Recovery is going well. I’ll be 100% by training camp and ready to lead this backfield.
event_description: Providing an injury update to Giants fans regarding his return for the 2026 season.

statement_made: The energy in Nashville this week was incredible. The NFL Draft continues to be a world-class celebration of football.
event_description: Closing statement following the conclusion of the 2026 NFL Draft.

statement_made: I'm not looking over my shoulder. Coach Hafley has given me the keys and I’m ready to drive.
event_description: Commenting on his status as the Dolphins' projected starter under new HC Jeff Hafley.

statement_made: I’ve seen a lot of young QBs, but Mendoza’s poise reminds me a bit of—dare I say—myself. Good luck, kid.
event_description: Analyzing No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza during an Omaha Productions draft recap segment.
